children: Australian shares were expected to open lower on Monday, potentially weighed by mining stocks amid weaker prices, while sentiment may be dampened by rising bets on an interest rate hike by U.S. Federal Reserve after Chair Kevin Warsh's speech.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) fell 0.4%, a 83.3-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark closed 0.6% higher on Friday.
